fusions.name: Harvest Arc
fusions.desc: Reaps a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 7 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance per hit to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Cut Down
fusions.desc: A sweeping blow on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Gleaned Strength
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Harvest Home
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
